examples.question: What must an NBFC provide to borrowers regarding recovery grievance redressal?

evidence.document: Reserve Bank of India (Non-Banking Financial Companies – Responsible Business Conduct) Directions, 2025 (Updated as on July 1, 2026)
evidence.span: The details of this mechanism shall be provided to the borrower at the time of loan disbursal.

examples.question: Which existing projects or loans are exempt from the provisions mentioned in paragraph 118?

evidence.document: Reserve Bank of India (Non-Banking Financial Companies – Resolution of Stressed Assets) Directions, 2025 (updated as on October 1, 2026)
evidence.span: existing projects which are specified in paragraph 102

examples.question: What are the requirements for an SPE when the originator has purchased loans from another lender, particularly regarding board representation and compliance with capital adequacy guidelines?

evidence.document: Reserve Bank of India (Non-Banking Financial Companies – Securitisation Transactions) Directions, 2025 (Updated as on July 01, 2026)
evidence.span: only one of either the originator or the lender from whom loans were purchased by the originator, may have the representative on the board of the SPE.

examples.question: What were the requirements for qualifying assets for NBFC-MFIs as of January 29, 2024?

evidence.document: Master Direction - Reserve Bank of India (Regulatory Framework for Microfinance Loans) Directions, 2022 (Updated as on 10-10-2024)
evidence.span: Qualifying assets of NBFC-MFIs shall constitute a minimum of 60 percent of the total assets (netted off by intangible assets), on an ongoing basis.

examples.question: How should a bank calculate its capital requirements when it provides credit protection on a securitisation exposure?

evidence.document: Master Direction - Reserve Bank of India (Securitisation of Standard Assets) Directions, 2021 (Updated as on 05-12-2022)
evidence.span: it must calculate its capital requirements as if it directly holds the portion of the securitisation exposure on which it has provided credit protection

examples.question: What are the obligations of a card-issuer regarding the disclosure of a cardholder's PIN or code?

evidence.document: Reserve Bank of India (Non-Banking Financial Companies – Credit Cards: Issuance and Conduct) Directions, 2025
evidence.span: shall be under an obligation not to disclose the cardholder’s PIN or code to anyone, except to the cardholder.

examples.altered_fact: The year of the directions is incorrectly stated as 2023 instead of 2025.
